content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Home medical equipment and diabetes supplies delivered to patients is a different business from software and billing for providers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Employer HR, benefits and payroll outsourcing is a different business from healthcare provider billing and EHR software."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Clinical staffing and locum placements are a labor business, not provider software or revenue cycle outsourcing."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Small-business HCM and payroll software serves employers, not healthcare providers, and lacks clinical or billing workflows."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Donor management and fundraising software for nonprofits and schools differs from provider EHR and billing software."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Telecom and media billing software and operations serve communications operators, not healthcare providers."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Free physician network funded by pharma marketing and trial recruitment is a different revenue model from provider software."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise customer engagement and service software is horizontal and not built for healthcare provider workflows."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Patient experience and employee survey programs with benchmarking differ from billing, EHR and revenue cycle services."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Broad HCM and payroll platform for US employers is a different business from healthcare provider software and billing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Payroll and HR software for mid-sized employers differs from provider EHR, practice management and revenue cycle work."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Physician staffing for hospitals is a clinical services business; its revenue cycle line is secondary to physician care."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Mainly a medical and dental products manufacturer; its coding and documentation services are a minor part of the business."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Enterprise social media and customer experience software is a different product for marketing and service teams."},{"label":"C15","good":true,"reason":"Sells EHR, revenue cycle and patient engagement software plus outsourced billing to hospitals, closely matching the target."},{"label":"C16","good":false,"reason":"Cloud software for life sciences companies serves pharma and device makers, not healthcare providers or billing operations."}]}
